Definition: Complete HPA profile is dispersed (score >10% with a reference ≥2 nTPM), or the active concentration gate fails; no CTA route remains.
Qualifying Reproductive evidence, but no qualifying cancer expression; the normal screen passes.
Cited expression in activated nonreproductive normal cells; a localized indirect atlas signal cannot establish Reproductive identity.
Two distinct tumors ≥10 native TPM or reviewed reliable tumor protein, with low measured normal/developmental expression; not established tumor restriction.
Positive Disposable RNA/protein; measured RNA elsewhere below the descriptive 2-unit floor and no detected protein elsewhere, including low measured developmental RNA.
All measured normal RNA below the descriptive 2-unit floor and no detected normal protein. Cancer expression need not be low.
Supported nonreproductive normal RNA reaches the descriptive 2-unit floor or reliable protein is detected; no preceding subtype or CTA definition qualifies.
Reproductive signals are below admission requirements or lack support; no preceding subtype qualifies and no supported appreciable nonreproductive expression is established.
